args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

In `nextRunAt`, the weekly cadence calculation currently unconditionally advances `next` by 7 days without checking whether `next <= from`. When a weekly export is created before the run hour on its first day, `next` is already strictly after `from`, but because there is no check like the daily cadence has, it adds another 7 days instead of scheduling for the same day. Add the `if (next <= from)` check (or compute the next occurrence correctly) for weekly cadences so the first run isn't skipped.
args.title: Fix weekly scheduled exports skipping the first week when created on run day
